He is so lucky to have vets like Steph, Dray and Jimmy who have been there, done that.

He's gonna absorb so much knowledge from them all season long!

quote.author: Tomer Azarly
quote.text:
Yaxel Lendeborg finished tonight's game with 31 points, 12 rebounds, and 6 assists.

Per @stathead.com, Lendeborg is the 2nd rookie in NBA history to record 30-12-6 in under 31 minutes of play.

The only other rookie to do so was Victor Wembanyama who did it in March 2024.
